listings.name: Hardwicks of Kyneton
listings.description: Family-owned retail butcher on Mollison Street in Kyneton selling lamb, beef, pork and chicken direct to the public.
listings.caveats: Business describes itself as also processing and supplying meat; the retail shop is open to the public. Public holiday hours not checked.

listings.name: Strath Hill Butcher
listings.otherProducts: Burgers, sausages, seafood and meat packs
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 7:30am-5:30pm, Saturday 7:30am-12pm, Sunday closed
listings.description: Family-owned butcher shop at the corner of Condon Street and Edwards Road in Bendigo selling beef, lamb, pork and poultry.
listings.caveats: Site gives the locality only as 'Bendigo' with no postcode; the exact suburb for the corner address should be confirmed before geocoding. Site lists poultry, recorded here as chicken.

listings.name: Bertie's Butcher
listings.otherProducts: Sausages; small on-site smoker and grill counter
listings.hoursAsStated: Store open Monday to Friday 8am-7pm, Saturday 8am-5pm, Sunday 10am-4pm
listings.description: Butcher shop on Swan Street in Cremorne with an attached smoker and grill counter.
listings.caveats: Older third-party coverage places the shop in Richmond; the shop's own site gives Cremorne 3121. Separate shorter hours on the site apply to the grill counter, not the butcher.

listings.name: The Daylesford Meat Co.
listings.hoursAsStated: Shop trading hours Monday to Thursday 7am-5:30pm, Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 7am-1pm, Sunday 10am-3pm
listings.description: Traditional butcher shop on Vincent Street in Daylesford selling beef, lamb, pork and chicken.
listings.caveats: Also delivers and supplies wholesale customers; the Vincent Street shop is open to the public.

listings.name: Meat @ Beany's
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 7am-2pm, Sunday closed
listings.description: Family-owned and operated butcher shop on Commercial Road in Koroit.

listings.name: Brendan Bouchier's Mortlake Butchers
listings.hoursAsStated: Business hours Monday to Friday 9am-5pm, Saturday and Sunday closed
listings.description: Butcher shop on Dunlop Street in Mortlake selling beef, lamb, pork and house-made smallgoods.
listings.caveats: Contact page labels these 'Business Hours'; no Saturday trading is unusual for a country butcher, so confirm they are the shop's counter hours. The same owner runs a separate Timboon shop (see unverified).

listings.name: Gippsland Butchers Block
listings.otherProducts: Seafood, pet food, condiments and meat packs
listings.hoursAsStated: Trading hours Monday to Friday 8am-6pm, Saturday 8am-1pm
listings.description: Locally owned, family-operated butcher shop on York Street in Sale.
listings.caveats: Hours conflict: the shop's own contact page says weekdays 8am-6pm, while the Wellington Shire tourism page says weekdays 8am-4:30pm (Saturday 8am-1pm on both). Own site recorded. The homepage refers to 'our stores' but only the York St shop is listed. Also has a wholesale arm.

listings.name: Casalinga Gourmet Meats
listings.otherProducts: Smallgoods, charcuterie, sausages and game meats
listings.hoursAsStated: Tuesday to Friday 7am-6pm; closed Saturday to Monday
listings.description: Family-owned corner butcher on Charles Street in central Launceston that also makes its own smallgoods.

listings.name: Vermey's Quality Meats
listings.otherProducts: Veal, game, deli items and sausages
listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 7am-4pm (homepage); contact page gives 6am opening
listings.description: Family butcher shop on Sandy Bay Road in Hobart's Sandy Bay with a walk-in shop and local delivery.
listings.caveats: Opening time conflicts on the shop's own site: homepage says 7am, contact page says 6am (closing times agree). Later 7am recorded. Site lists poultry, recorded here as chicken; milk and eggs are sold via online orders, confirm they are stocked in-store.
